admitted_terms.definition: The source-declared canonical Stem coordinate of a New Ithkuil lexicon sense.
admitted_terms.cardinality: exactly one per admitted lexicon sense
admitted_terms.source_justification: The tracked sense row explicitly records STEM 1 as a semantic coordinate distinct from Specification.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Stem is a semantic coordinate of the sense, not its lexical notation.

non_goals: Does not imply ordering among Stem numbers.

admitted_terms.definition: The source-declared Specification coordinate of a New Ithkuil lexicon sense.
admitted_terms.cardinality: exactly one per admitted lexicon sense
admitted_terms.source_justification: The tracked sense row explicitly records BSC separately from Stem and meaning text.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Specification is a source coordinate, not semantic subsumption.

non_goals: Does not create a Specification taxonomy.

admitted_terms.definition: Relates an addressable New Ithkuil root resource to one independently identified semantic sense concept parsed for that root.
admitted_terms.cardinality: zero or more senses per root; exactly one parent root per admitted sense
admitted_terms.source_justification: The real sense row binds one stable root coordinate to one independently identified BSC STEM 1 sense.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The root is not a SKOS Concept and the relation is not taxonomy.
Would require broader LexicalEntry/LexicalSense ontology adoption not made by this profile.

non_goals: Not symmetric, transitive, hierarchical, or a SKOS subproperty.

admitted_terms.definition: Relates one source-derived affix-degree semantic concept to the resolved semantic affix-root resource whose degree it is.
admitted_terms.cardinality: exactly one per admitted affix-degree concept
admitted_terms.source_justification: The source row records degree 1 meaning for a specific affix-root atomic ID; the degree concept and root have separate identities.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Degree membership in an affix root is not semantic subsumption.
The degree concept is a semantic value of a root, not asserted physical/logical containment.

non_goals: Does not order degree concepts or encode curriculum progression.

admitted_terms.definition: The source-written structural surface pattern of a composition, distinct from any realized surface form.
admitted_terms.source_justification: The Modular adjunct row has an explicit structural pattern and no concrete surface form.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Concrete compositions can carry both a realized form and structural pattern; one value role would collapse them.

non_goals: Not a semantic label or SKOS notation.

admitted_terms.definition: A source-stated applicability or realization condition attached to a linguistic construction, component occurrence, or explicit allomorph rule.
admitted_terms.cardinality: zero or one per current composition/component; exactly one per current allomorph rule
admitted_terms.source_justification: The real composition row records an operative y-conditioned alternation separately from its semantic summary.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Flattening operative conditions into semantic descriptions loses their machine role.

non_goals: Does not define a general rule-reasoning language.

admitted_terms.definition: The source-declared number of linguistic component occurrences in a composition.
admitted_terms.source_justification: The Standard formative row declares nine components and the component table contains exactly nine occurrences.

rejected_alternatives.reason: DCMI extent denotes size or duration, not linguistic component cardinality.

non_goals: Does not itself assert component edges or order.

admitted_terms.definition: The source-declared linguistic role of one composition component occurrence.
admitted_terms.cardinality: exactly one per admitted component occurrence
admitted_terms.source_justification: The real component row distinguishes the type/degree-vowel role from its atomic value and slot label.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The current source role is a controlled linguistic role literal, not an RDF class assignment.

admitted_terms.definition: The exact source slot label attached to a composition component occurrence.
admitted_terms.cardinality: zero or one per admitted component occurrence
admitted_terms.source_justification: The source component independently records slot V_X in addition to its role and atomic target.

rejected_alternatives.reason: A slot coordinate is not the human-readable label of the occurrence resource.

admitted_terms.definition: The exact source input pattern of an explicit allomorph substitution rule.
admitted_terms.cardinality: exactly one per admitted allomorph rule
admitted_terms.source_justification: The source rule explicitly distinguishes fbm input from fv intermediate and vw output.

rejected_alternatives.reason: One unqualified value cannot distinguish input, intermediate and output roles on the same rule.

admitted_terms.definition: The exact optional intermediate pattern explicitly supplied by a multi-step allomorph rule.
admitted_terms.cardinality: zero or one per admitted allomorph rule
admitted_terms.source_justification: The source explicitly records fv between fbm input and vw output; omitting the role would erase a source distinction.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Cannot distinguish the optional intermediate role from input/output on the same rule.

non_goals: Does not imply recursive rule execution.

admitted_terms.definition: The exact source output pattern of an explicit allomorph substitution rule.
admitted_terms.cardinality: exactly one per admitted allomorph rule
admitted_terms.source_justification: The source explicitly distinguishes vw output from fbm input and fv intermediate.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The source records conditional string-pattern transformation, not one RDF resource replacing another.

non_goals: Does not create a new semantic concept for the output form.

admitted_terms.definition: The exact source domain label stating the linguistic structure to which an explicit allomorph rule applies.
admitted_terms.cardinality: exactly one per admitted allomorph rule
admitted_terms.source_justification: The current rule source names C_A affix-complex as its affected domain and supplies no allomorph-group or semantic-concept ID.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The rule table supplies no allomorph_group_id; minting one would manufacture a source relation.

non_goals: Does not turn the domain label into a semantic concept link.

reviewed_not_admitted.reason: The value is extractor/source-mode provenance metadata, while #60 freezes linguistic semantic residue and explicitly excludes provenance vocabulary. Keep it in records/receipts unless a provenance owner later admits a public term.
RDF container membership predicates rdf:_1, rdf:_2, ... preserve the actual source order without a custom position property.
rdf:value as xsd:nonNegativeInteger faithfully carries the degree scalar on the degree concept.
The #35 fixture term demonstrated admission mechanics only; #59 source requires distinct input/intermediate/output roles, so the generic replacement example is not frozen.
